title: Autocannon ammunition for the listed Cleavers and Broadaxes: standard rounds boxes at The Anvil Arsenal
note: Written by Apophis, 2026-11-24 13:05 UTC (orders ENT-087 O2 and block APOPHIS: hulls batched by listing). The Cleavers and Broadaxes listed by the Crimson Empire Treasury come with autocannons, a railgun or a missile launcher at 0 rounds (get_ship of a Cleaver bought 13:00 UTC: autocannon_i 0/500, missile_launcher_i 0/8); a hunt with an empty magazine and no ammunition aboard ends without a fight (hunt.py reload_if_low). One standard rounds box fully loads any autocannon magazine (catalog); The Anvil Arsenal asks 6 cr with 9,398 units (books 13:03 UTC). Four boxes per pilot, once: two load the guns at the next hunt, two spare; 500 rounds last many hunts. open_to drone and sentinel (rule F23, the Admiral's exception): the class guard reads a buy circuit as trade, but this is ammunition for the ship's own fitted weapons; nothing is sold. Booked once. 2026-11-24 13:08 UTC (Apophis): buy max_price 15 -> 16, over the ask gate plus the runner's 1 percent tax (routes.py check). 2026-11-24 15:29 UTC (Apophis): `standing` true: the dispatcher closed it 'at a loss: 4 runs, -3,083 cr in 6 hours' (dispatch.why_not) while two guns still stood empty; ammunition for a ship's own weapons is fitting, judged by kills, not by its fuel.
